baseline_subtraction.reference: mean of captured generated-token maps strictly before the target span

interpretation: These are routing-based diagnostics, not causal feature attributions. The value-norm correction suppresses high-attention paths whose value vectors carry little magnitude. Optional baseline subtraction compares a target with only earlier generated tokens in this completion; it is not a separately measured resting-state control and never uses future tokens.

methods.attention: last-query direct attention over image-token keys
methods.rollout: residual-aware cross-layer rollout across every captured full-attention block
methods.value_norm: per-head attention multiplied by the corresponding KV-head value-vector L2 norm, then normalized across all attended keys
methods.value_norm_rollout: value-norm-corrected, residual-aware cross-layer rollout across every captured full-attention block
